New Feature: Co-op mode
“Shared co-op” is our first multiplayer mode. It means that up to 4 players can play one faction together without limitations. Any team member may place buildings, paths, send commands or change settings at any time for that one faction.

To team up, there are 3 ways:

You can join a Steam friend currently playing Pioneers of Pagonia anytime, if that player has set their game to “open for friends” and not to “private”.

While you are running a game, you can also invite Steam friends to join your game via the Steam friend invite overlay.

You can also copy a game ID of your current match and share it with other people to allow them to join. This is helpful if you want someone to join who is not on your Steam friend-list or if you want to make sure that only specific players who received the code can enter. To that end, players who have your current game ID can join even if your game is set to “private”, so no random friends can join in who just happen to see you play in Steam.

Multiplayer Saves: 

Any player participating can save multiplayer games, any player participating can continue the saved games. Other players can join until the player limit, currently 4 players, is reached. While the player who set up the map is defined as the host, anyone else can take over that role in a restart when loading a save game. They can also continue alone later if they want to, so savegames can be used both for single player or shared co-op gameplay.


Interface Features:

You can see a list of all participating players and their connection quality. 

Each player receives an individual player color, which is used to differentiate the players in the user interface. The color is visible at the player name list for easy recognition.

You can see where other players currently plan to place a building with an outline of their player color.

You can see the camera position of other team members on the overview map in their player color.

You and your team members can “ping” locations in the world (even multiple ones at a time) to mark points of interest, and those are both shown on the overview map and the world view in the respective player color.

If one or more players select a building, this is also visualized in the game world view with an outline border of their player color.

Playing Together:

The host can pause the game by entering the game menu (ESC key)

The host can change the game speed

If commands of team members conflict, they get automatically resolved. E.g. if one interaction turns another one invalid, e.g. because there is no longer enough room for a building, the first command stays valid. 

The UI feedback (e.g. you see if another player currently selects a building, probably to change settings) helps to avoid simultaneous actions unless intended. But parallel actions are still allowed whenever possible, e.g. multiple players can adjust settings, in the same building simultaneously.

notes.title: Economy Update 0.4.0
notes.content:
Dear Pioneers,

We are beyond excited to announce the release of our first major Economy Update. The Fishing Hut was by far the most requested building after we launched into Early Access last year in December and we are so happy to finally share it with you! Do you prefer to go fishing at sunny beaches or calm lakes in Pagonia? We definitely enjoy both!

What's new?

Fisher and Fishing Hut 
New Commodities: Trout and Herring
Warehouse Storage Building with 8 Piles
Production and Unit Statistics
Increased Camera Zoom 
Improved Shadow Quality
And many more improvements!

Find the full list of changes in the patch notes below.

[hr][/hr]
Developer Notes
It's time to pick up the tools, Pioneers! Or should we say, the fishing rods? Because from now on, not only does it feel like you are watching a fish tank, but you can actually watch schools of fish swimming in the ocean and lakes of Pagonia! Let us tell you everything you need to know:

The Fishing Hut

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/3e70c67d9a1c8881f4c472b77e0e95bffece1355.png

The Fishing Hut is a gathering building (like the Hunter’s Lodge) with three workers who work independently from each other. Fishers are recruited at the Guild Hall and need a fishing rod as their tool, which is made at the Wood Workshop. The Fishing Hut can be placed anywhere and has a maximum range and a focus point like other gathering buildings in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/4ee58f4d8fc1a744139ee9af7f5644e4490a7c29.png

How does Fishing work?
Fish can spawn in any body of water in Pagonia. There are two types of fish:

Ocean Fish (Herring) with a nutritious meal value of 6
Lake Fish (Trout) with a comfort meal value of 6

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/3b8c944448f50b07aff72747974bc0928bae7716.gif

Unlike to other wild animals in Pagonia, you do not see the actual number of fish in the game world, but you will need to look for schools of fish in the water, which are an indicator of fish occurrence. You will be able to adjust the number of fish in the ocean and in lakes in the map generation settings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/79966d43bb1ef753a35ebee5b93406ea04f3fe59.gif

Pagonian fishers are quite skilled in their profession and will prefer fishing spots with more fish in range. However, they do not catch a fish with every try. If they fail to catch a fish after three tries in a row, they will return to their hut empty handed. Hope for better luck next time!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/795cf33e416a992282a81e6359fcb465d374c523.gif

Fish serves as an additional source of food that is quite easy to obtain. Like other food commodities, fish will be prepared for comfort and nutritious meals at the Tavern. However, fish can also be used for rations prepared at the Provisioner.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/6264b42bf4761bc25de185584fdba606fd6b64d2.png

Warehouse Storage Building

It's bigger, it's better, it is the big Warehouse building! Now you can store up to 8 different commodities and up to 64 units per piles in total. If you like to keep your resources in order, you can choose and set the contents of each pile manually or use a template for quick setups. Each pile can be manually set to priority.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/8a63385190f397795308b4f099e516dacae7e1e4.png

Production and Unit Statistics

We also decided to add statistics to provide over-time feedback on request for many different economy values. You can access the small graphs with a quick mouse-over while playing. They always reflect the last hour to grant context and include information on commodities that were traded or lost.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/47040310b64b20f0e199acf55f148f050ce5cc2d.png

You will also have a much better overview of your population growth. With the new unit statistics tooltips you can observe the development of total values like balance of homes, total amount of units (combat, construction, carrier etc.) and many more! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/1163704cdda2cdbe660eb0b3e863aa4c56213762.png

Camera Zoom
This was also highly requested by the community. It is now possible to zoom out the camera further to get a better overview of your beautiful Pagonian villages. Enjoy the "Wuselfaktor" from above! :)

We hope you get some early summer vibes while going fishing at the beach or at dreamy lakes. We definitely cannot wait to read what you think! Please share your feedback with us in Discord or in the Steam forum. 

Happy fishing everyone!
Your Envision Entertainment  Team

New Features
Fisher

Herrings have been added to the ocean and Trout swim in the lakes
Your fishers head out to promising shores in range and try to catch them
Note that save games from the versions before 0.4.0 do not contain fish deposits, therefore the fisher has nothing to find
Fish can be used to create rations or supply market stalls
Herrings are used in nutrition meals, Trout in comfort meals
The comfort meal score needed to gain population beyond 750 Pagonians has been increased to reflect availability of fish
The amount of nutrition necessary for mining is unchanged for now as subsurface mining will impact this with a later game update


Warehouse Storage Building with 8 Piles

Offers space for up to 8 different commodities, and up to 64 units of each one
The contents of each pile can be chosen and set manually:
Any specific commodity (e.g. silver blade)
Any commodity of a group (e.g. any weapon, will be occupied as soon as production piles of any weapon type fill up)
Any commodity (will be occupied as soon as any production piles fill up)
Nothing (pile will be emptied / stay empty until changed)
Some templates offer quick setups, e.g. “construction depot” for all 8 commodities used for construction
Each pile can be manually set to priority. This means the Warehouse is supplied with priority for that commodity and will only redirect and offer these priority commodities to other buildings which are set to priority.
The functionality of the standard storage building has been adjusted to the same behavior.


Production Statistics

Production and consumption statistics added to the tooltip of each commodity
Reflect the production and consumption history of the last hour of each commodity
Includes information for commodities traded or lost (e.g. stolen)


Unit Statistics

Various statistics have been added to the tooltips of the unit interface
Reflect the changes during the last hour, delivering valuable information, e.g.
Amount of specific unit types like carriers, diggers or builders and how many of them are idle
Development of total values like Balance of homes, total amount of combat units, wealth and many more


Improvements

Gameplay

Reworked “Start new game” flow to better distinguish between guidance maps, preselected maps, generated maps and playing with / without enemies. 
Removed the original guidance map without NPC villages
Added two new maps to the predefined maps section
New storage building behavior
Configure piles individually or choose from several storage presets (e.g. mining resources, construction material, …) for all piles at once.
Priority storing and delivery can be set per pile. 
Reworked distribution of surplus commodities to storages and warehouses: The supply will now depend on fill state much more than on distance
This ensures that multiple distant locations get supplied simultaneously instead of the more distant ones only getting supplied after closer ones are full. 
It is useful to distribute commodities in advance and shorten delivery distance e.g. for border stones, construction materials, and more.
Manual production orders and building priority setting is removed from NPC Village buildings when merging with player
The camera can now be zoomed out further
Reduced amount of builders for the well from 2 to 1


Map Generation

Improved visual quality of shores and water areas
Improved road layout of NPC villages


Misc

Shadow quality has been improved
Rendering performance improvements in situations with a lot of piles on the screen
Added more LOD levels to a lot of assets to improve performance
Reduced VRAM usage 
Disabled generated maps on specific old graphic drivers which are known to be unable to support procedural map generation. To unlock map generation an updated driver is required, otherwise those systems can only play the preselected maps and save games created on another system.
Improved audio mixing
Added bonus track “Off To New Shores“ to the soundtrack
Improved various icons


Fixes

Fixed: The workflow animations at the wood workshops had bugs
Fixed: Workflow animations at the mint
Fixed: Idle builders were blocking carriers bringing commodities
Fixed: NPC camps were sometimes not destroyed after loosing all units
Fixed: Addresses some issues during road placement

notes.title: Patch 0.3.0
notes.content:
Dear Pioneers,

We are thrilled to announce our new Pioneers of Pagonia update! After we celebrated the successful launch of Early Access in December 2023, we have been able to spend some time working on updates and improvements.

What's new?

Unit Selection Menu
Attack Move Command
Claiming at Tower and Garrison can now be paused
Farmland can now be moved closer to the forest
Improvements in Map Generation and UI
And many more!

Find the full list of changes in the patch notes below.

[hr][/hr]
Developer Notes

Thank you for your support and the vast amount of positive comments and feedback we have received since our Early Access launch in December 2023. We are truly grateful for our dedicated community!

Currently, we are collecting all of your feedback online. Our list counts more than 400 different suggestions and ideas. So it will take some time to discuss all of it and decide what is coming next. (Believe me, there are some really cool things coming!)

At the same time we are working on major new content updates. We will give you more details about it soon. Stay tuned and keep the feedback coming. This really helps us to improve and make Pioneers of Pagonia the best game it can be.

Unit Selection Menu
First up is the new unit selection menu! For example, by clicking on a guard, you'll get more info about its duties, abilities and to which building it belongs. Quite neat, isn't it?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/c3ba1e03cea9ab501e2b4446fda418d2bc0a6172.gif

More Tooltips
This feature also comes in handy for your hunters! You are now able to see the reason why an animal / a unit died. Which helps judging your hunter's efficiency and provides more info on what's happening in the game world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/4d4d23516561e7e3cd44c55fd36e371b3a4548a3.gif

Unit Follow Button
With the unit selection menu comes the new follow button as requested by our community! By clicking on the little circle on the right, the camera follows the unit automatically. Now it's much more fun, observing what your Pagonians are up to!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/f9172b0d9ffd3213d2d5ece62658fc656b132789.gif

Attack Move Command
This feature was also highly requested by our community. We included a separate attack-button, which enables the player to send their military units to any explored area without range limitation. Also, your patrol point won't be changed and your units will return to it once that battle is done.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/4ebb05039b49ea21a47479bac7ce9aad7bc714e7.gif

Now, fighting Pagonians foes will be more organized. Get your weapons and armor ready!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/7523e9839475a85fcd3cfeb92821dd578633579e.pngNew Attack Move Command Button (sword icon)

Pausing Territory Claiming
One more major improvement is, that the claiming of territory can be paused. Hooray! No more guards serving as a little snack for hungry werewolves. :) Your guards can now chill in their safe place, while soldiers and fearnaughts do the dirty work. Border Stones will automatically be carried to other buildings, when claiming is stopped.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/c358e74ecf4998eb578649e1dcd34b92233203fb.pngClaiming territory pause button

We hope, you enjoy these improvements in your next game session. See you in Pagonia!

Pick up the tools, Pioneers. There is still so much do to!
Your Envision Entertainment  Team

notes.title: Dev Blog #6: Feature Update – Combat, Military & Enemy Types
notes.content:
Dear Pioneers,

Time is flying! Our closed beta playtest is almost ending, and Early Access launch day is just around the corner! A huge thanks to all our alpha and beta testers for providing such valuable feedback. This helps us tremendously. 

Before we return to our desks, we want to share with you some of the new features waiting for you in the Early Access Version! 

Since the beginning there is one question that has been asked the most by our community: How does combat work? Well, now we can finally share a few glimpses of our combat system! 

How Combat Works in Pioneers of Pagonia 
As many of you already know, Pioneers of Pagonia is no RTS. But you can control your units from the guard tower or the garrison. From there you can select the patrol point and click on the area where your military units should patrol. If there are enemies in the area, they will automatically engage in an attack. 

Enemy Types and How to Defeat Them 
There are a variety of enemies lurking in the fog! Some are easier and some are quite tough to defeat. Each enemy type has several tier levels (usually tier 1 to 3) which determines the enemy’s strength. The higher the tier-level, the stronger your military units must be to defeat them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/8c697f120a393a4740fecd95700417267d396c7d.gif

Bandits
Bandits are crafty swordsmen and a real threat to your Pagonians. Depending on their tier-level they can be quite tough to defeat. You need to train higher-tier-level soldiers to stand a chance against elite bandits for example. When your explorer spots a bandit camp near your village, you will receive a notification. Explorer and other units fear enemies and will run away as soon as they encounter dangers!

Thieves
Thieves will sneak into your village and steal valuable resources from your storage or treasury. What makes them hard to spot is their ability to disguise themselves as carrier units! Before they start to raid your village, they mask themselves, walk as a carrier unit into your village, steal the resource and bring it back to their camp. The only way to stop them is to attack their camp or train rangers in the adventurer's guild to expose the impostor and catch them before they steal your goods! 

Werewolves 
There are also mythical creatures roaming through the fog of Pagonia! Hungry werewolves are not to be messed with! They spawn in their moon glen and are one of the most dangerous enemies in Pagonia. Guards and soldiers will have a tough time defeating werewolves and are more likely to perish under the sharp claws and fangs of a werewolf. What makes them even more dangerous is their ability to bite your Pagonians and turn them into werewolves! Once this happens, your units will walk straight to the moon glen and transform into a werewolf themselves. You will need to train fearnaughts to defeat these feisty creatures! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/667bb86e824dbc2006be7076a91861af045c8705.gif

Spectres 
These unsettling creatures will send shivers down your spine! Spectres can be found next to a mysterious broken tomb and haunt your village if you get too close to their camp. It is best to send your fiercest units to defeat them. But we will not reveal them yet. If you want to find out more about this ghostly enemy type, you will have to wait for our Early Access release. :) 

Impact on Economy
Of course, combat has an impact on your economy. If you want to train powerful military units, you need to gather resources and forge weapons and armor to provide for your soldiers. For Early Access there will be guards, soldiers, rangers and fearnaughts that can be trained in the military academy. All of them will have several tier levels (tier 1 to 3), depending on what kind of armor and weapons you are providing. 

There are more enemy types and military units on our agenda, but we will tackle these after Early Access. Now we are curious to know about your ideas for enemy types and military units! What do you think is missing in Pagonia? You are always welcome to share feedback and ideas on our discord server. 

Outlook: Map Gen, Neutral Factions and More! 
We seriously cannot wait to show you everything we have been working on in the last months! We are so excited for you to experience the unique islands of Pagonia and uncover the secrets that wait in the fog for you. Thank you for following us on our journey so far. Keep your eyes peeled for more updates until Early Access!

notes.title: Dev-Blog #002: Get to know Pagonia
notes.content:
Hello Steam-Community!

Thanks for all your kind comments and likes on our first Dev-Blog and the »Get to know Pagonia«-Series. Today we would like to share more information about the game! Especially the food resources, which are planned for Early Access, and all the steps it takes to feed everyone living in Pagonia. 😊

So, let's start!

There are several resources that can be hunted, gathered or harvested. For example, the fisher will catch herrings in the ocean and trout in lakes, while the hunter pursues rabbits, wild boars and deer. But not all food supplies will come from animals. The forager can find hidden porcini and delicious raspberries. Whereas farmers are growing crops and vegetables.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/4632b5bfed72104ebe5ba4d1576f8b51b17e1db1.png

Farming

Pagonian farmers are working on fields nearby the vegetable farm. For Early Access, you can grow pumpkins and cabbages. After sowing the seed and watering the plants with water from the well (which the units will do automatically) the veggies will be harvested and delivered to market stalls.
 
The crop farm is designed for growing wheat, corn and flax. Once harvested, the goods are waiting to be picked up for further processing. Corn goes to the market stalls and wheat goes to the windmill for producing flour. Flax will be carried to the weaver where it is used to make cloth and rope. However, flax does not need to be grown, it can be foraged, too.

Good farmers know their land! In Pagonia it does make a difference where certain plants are grown. For example, the cultivation of wheat requires more fertile lands, which are much harder to find. Pumpkins, on the other hand, grow pretty much everywhere! In order to get the best farming results, you can assign the farm field according to the different terrain types.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/55492e61a8175222f9807dbcd14cc98bb0b009b1.png

Tavern

Obviously, wheat is the main ingredient for baking bread, but you will have to mill it first, add water from a well and use firewood to heat the oven of the bakery. 

The meal ingredients will be delivered to market stalls, where cooks of the tavern will fetch them and prepare excellent meals. But to have delicious meals on the table, the cooks of Pagonia must prepare the food accordingly, which happens in the tavern.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/c0681bec38e0e57e22eeac6671d8b63263dc2173.png

Meals & Rations

The cooks will collect food ingredients from nearby market stalls based on suitability and availability. One type of meal preferably uses ingredients with high nutritional value, like bread or boar meat, which is made for craftsmen doing heavy work like mining.

But what about the rest of Pagonia's inhabitants? The other type of meal is for the occupants of the residences in which the new little Pagonians are born. The residents will have their lunch and dinner at the tavern, and they prefer to eat deer meat and porcini mushrooms a lot more than eating pumpkins!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/0bb87b3a9d7628fea265b825b187eb593eba29b8.png

In order to preserve food for a longer period of time, fish and meat will be smoked at the provisioner. In combination with bread from the bakery the cooks working at provisioner will produce rations for civilian units like explorers to travel beyond your borders and use their skills elsewhere. 

No Pagonian will do their work with an empty stomach, this is a fact! 😊

notes.title: Dev-Blog #001: Get to know Pagonia
notes.content:
Hello Steam-Community!
Thank you all for your huge support and the many messages we received since our announcement of Pioneers of Pagonia in February 2023. The game is in pre-alpha-status, but we cannot wait to share more info with you! In the past weeks we have been uploading a few glimpses behind the scenes of developing the game on social media. So, it’s about time, we share some more information with you on steam as well!

Let’s begin with our »Get-to-know-Pagonia«-Series, where we show several aspects of the game, the lore and general features in Pioneers of Pagonia.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/08b19b53d6323e3e305730b1876ee5f049dfc953.png

The World of Pagonia
Originally, Pagonia is a world of countless islands populated with scattered villages, where skillful inhabitants live in peace. A cataclysm of unknown origin caused the world to get out of balance: Forests are infested with thorn tendrils, mountain passes are impassable by landslides, villages are invaded by thieves and cursed creatures are sighted in many places. This separates the villages from each other and causes their inhabitants to face serious challenges.

This is where you come in! Your goal is to lead the Pagonians as a visionary and forge alliances with the inhabitants, helping each other and gaining their trust. You will send out your pioneers to discover untouched soil, find hidden resources and explore secret places.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/5b0669edeb05ded0b172c49a18a671a8b08210c3.png

Procedural Maps
The infinite variations of the procedurally generated maps offer new challenges every time. Procedural generation of content is a powerful tool which is already very important for many games. Some people mistake procedural generation with complete randomness. Instead, it means there is a designed ruleset which creates interesting content, where the quality can be improved by better rules and algorithms continuously.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/3ae42a2cb2116e4caf480fc0ba7a8d55e2098e60.png

For Pioneers of Pagonia, a simulation with many different interconnected game systems, procedural content fits excellently. We procedurally generate the map layout and terrain distribution, resource amount and allocation, locations for hostile and friendly inhabitants and their objectives. The combination of those challenges will be unique on each map. Another advantage of procedural content is that it leads to unusual situations, which a level designer may have never thought of.

Meet the Pagonians
They are the protagonists of the game! Without them, Pagonia would not be such a busy place, as it is their purpose to take jobs as workers, builders, carriers and many more. They play an essential role in the flourishing economy of Pagonia, as we are aiming to achieve several thousand units bustling around the world going on about their business and keep things going!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/a52720bffba5971f710786233752b7e5fcf9b409.png

One of the frequently asked questions is, if there is a combat system or how the combat system works. In Pioneers of Pagonia we will not offer RTS-like unit controls. Instead, military and mystical units are tied to buildings as their base and will be controlled from there, e.g. by telling them where to claim new territory, which area to guard or which location to scout for enemies.

Units, which patrol or scout an area and find a preferable target they are looking for, will automatically engage. For example, your guards will chase thieves away. Soldiers will attack bandits, but hostile spirits will attack your soldiers, while your sorcerers hunt the spirits. Depending on unit types and their individual strength and weaknesses, there are good and bad match ups.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/123d9fcfbbb00b3b1528da993c69e9c261619e53.jpg

Buildings & Production
In Pagonia every transportation, resource gathering, and production process is visualized. Besides that, the game world delivers a lot more visual information. A few examples for visualization are: harvestable plants, different terrain types, the status and setup of buildings, the amount of input and output goods at a building and much more. The goal is, that everyone can fully understand what is happening, just by watching the game world.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/3902dc8bd5df2c179aa369eacecffd49204bbba1.png

Keep in mind that you do not have to control the units, they automatically execute your orders! The main interface offers a summary of all your available units, resources, and buildings with additional information, such as how many carriers are idle, how many goods stored surplus or how many buildings of a specific type are still under construction. Notifications keep you updated about notable events and the resizable mini map ensures a good overview.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/b6969a1dd875bdd5145bd40fd536b39e08d476bd.png

For Early Access, we will have more than 40 different buildings available and plan to continuously extend the tech-tree after that step by step. We also decided to focus on a single faction for Early Access. Instead of offering multiple player factions with fewer buildings and limited production chains, we decided to go for one bigger faction with much more variety. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/ce9dccbf0377a1b20490b64e2a445c5f69f00897.png

Additionally, there will be more than 70 different commodities in the player's production chains. As we plan to release additional building types later, the variety of goods will continue to increase. With thousands of wares transported at once, logistics will play an important role in Pioneers of Pagonia. Bad planning may cause a collapse by overburdened transport units or incredible traffic jams at bottlenecks. Details about road types and transport units are not yet defined and will be revealed later.
